mechanicalContract.packingScope: Upper20k/c0 unlimited length-travel fixed by user. No lower external spring; finite64MN/m cell retained. Prior catalog metadata inactive and not a spring packing qualification.

upperObserver.contract: Four-state causal upper observer driven by the explicit local matched acquired axial cell deviation, identified holder inertia and a proper critically damped cell derivative. Only observer Q/R design weights and derivative cutoff vary; actual sensor noise/timing, physical mechanics and PI/notch remain unchanged.

developmentContract: Eight proper causal acceleration-current-FF leads on each of parent observer24/33, chosen from previous case7 development recordings. Exact same11 cases/seeds and twoA masses. No fresh-test outcomes read, no learning, no guide/physical/sensor changes. Force reconstruction, normal estimate and measurement-frame observer unchanged. Preparing352cases is not executed qualification.
profileIndexContract: zero-based scenario = 176*observerIndex0 +22*(leadID1-1)+11*massAIndex0+caseID0. observerIndex0=0 selects parent24,1 selects parent33. massAIndex0=0 selects.4kg,1 selects1.5kg. gainID aliases leadFamilyID1=8*observerIndex0+leadID1; controlBaseGainID stays1.
designWeightContract: Force/acceleration densities and positionAlgorithmRms_m are observer tuning weights; they do not change actual injected noise, quantization, calibration, sensor response, acquisition, pipeline or latency. New derivative cutoff changes only the cell-deformation term in deltaFa.
